pages.title: MotifJS Documentation
pages.description: What MotifJS does, an index of the sections, and a quick look through a slice of a notes list.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.description: Set up the build, write your first component and mount the application, with or without JSX.

pages.title: Components
pages.description: Class, function and Options API components, with and without JSX; the root element, `view()` and `controls`, names of class members.

pages.title: Creating Components
pages.description: Creating a component from start to finish: definition, element, content, props and use, in the class, function and Options forms.

pages.title: Props and Children
pages.description: Data flow between components: `props`, prop types, live props and placing content with `childs`.

pages.title: controls and the Component Tree
pages.description: The child control collection `controls`, moving around the component tree, and moving content somewhere else.

pages.title: Element and Appearance
pages.description: Reaching a component's element and its inner tags: `element`, `ref`, `onRefCreated`; `class`, `attr`, `style` and `setText`.

pages.title: The motif Namespace
pages.description: Framework operations on a component: `show`/`hide`/`toggle`, `on`/`off`/`trigger`, `setDisposable`/`register`, `clear`, `stopAnimations` and `motif.options`.

pages.title: bindings
pages.description: A component's bindings: what live expressions in JSX turn into, the `bindings` members, `watch` and the lifetime of a binding.

pages.title: State, Context and Services
pages.description: A component's state flags, its reactive state and `setState`; reaching the application (`context`) and services; `build` and `dispose`.

pages.title: Async Results with using
pages.description: `using`, which drops a result that arrives after the component is disposed: the call form, handlers, MJX129 and when the check happens.

pages.title: Async Results with doWork
pages.description: `doWork`, which ties a promise to the component's lifetime: the returned promise, MJX108, `catch` and `finally`, how it differs from `using`.

pages.title: JSX and Templates
pages.description: How JSX comes down to core calls; text and attribute bindings, spread, class/style, x- directives, compile diagnostics and explain; the counterpart of every form without JSX.

pages.title: Views without JSX
pages.description: Writing by hand the motifComponent calls that JSX comes down to; call shapes, new Component, props keys, text nodes, preconfig, fragments for branches and lists, class components in files without JSX, reading the compiled output.

pages.title: Reactivity
pages.description: reactive, createSignal, createComputed, createLazyComputed, effect, untracked, and how bindings meet the DOM; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Conditional Rendering and Lists
pages.description: x-wait/x-display, && and the ternary operator, .map lists, key and item identity, switch and the binding API; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Events
pages.description: DOM events and modifiers, motif.on/off/trigger component events, lifecycle events, the application event bus and service events with Emitter; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Forms and Two-Way Binding
pages.description: One-way value+oninput, two-way binding with bindings.model and x-model, select, form submission with onsubmit and a function action, a validation pattern; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Lifecycle
pages.description: The order of hooks, hooks as class methods and JSX props, initializeComponent, visibility, waiting, disposal and the application lifecycle; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Styling and Animation
pages.description: The class/style/attr helpers, inline <style>, the CSS class based transition prop, WAAPI keyframe transitions, visibility and the enter/leave mode.

pages.title: Memory Management and Disposal
pages.description: What is released on its own, motif.setDisposable/register, the dispose methods, detach/silentDetach/silentUnlink, DisposableStore, using/doWork, leak tracking and counting live components.

pages.title: Error Handling
pages.description: The difference between errors that are thrown, reported and written as warnings; MotifError, errorHandler, setUnexpectedErrorHandler and the safeCall helpers.

pages.title: Resilience
pages.description: Retry, timeout, circuit breaker, bulkhead, rate limiter and fallback policies with the Resilience.create chain; order, state and error codes.

pages.title: Windows
pages.description: Opening a component in a new window or in an always-on-top Picture-in-Picture window and taking it back; the window manager's rules, style mirroring, Electron.

pages.title: Introduction to Routing
pages.description: Setting up the router, how an address turns into nested layouts and pages, the useRouter options, navigation modes, the not-found route and the error page.

pages.title: The Route Table
pages.description: RouteItem fields, nested routes, redirect and alias, path parameters, querying the route table, lazy routes and the route check in development mode.

pages.title: RouterView
pages.description: RouterView, where route components are placed, nested and named outlets, and how a route component is built; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Links
pages.description: rel="router" links, RouterLink, and route classes on any component; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Navigation and Route State
pages.description: navigate and navigateByName, live route state, navigation direction and history entry state, scroll memory.

pages.title: Route Hooks and Guards
pages.description: Route lifecycle hooks, application-level guards, middleware, restarting and shutting down the router.

pages.title: Stack Navigation
pages.description: Mobile-style stack navigation; kept pages, the transition animation and swiping back.

pages.title: Introduction to Dependency Injection
pages.description: Registering services and resolving them from components; a full example from registration to use, and the DI error codes; with and without JSX.

pages.title: Registering Services
pages.description: ServiceCollection registration forms, singletons created at startup, automatic registration with @Injectable and its options.

pages.title: Lifetimes and Scopes
pages.description: singleton, scoped and transient; the navigation scope and scoped handles.

pages.title: Resolving Services
pages.description: ServiceProvider.get and getAsync, getService in a component, FromService, inject, deps and useApplication.

pages.title: Disposing Services
pages.description: Cleaning up services with app.dispose and provider.dispose, closing the navigation scope, tracking transient instances.

pages.title: Writing Packages on Motif
pages.description: The compiler output as the framework's open API; which mechanism theme, layer, layout, shell and plugin, data, wrapper, settings and transition packages rely on.

pages.title: Wrapping Third-Party Libraries
pages.description: Rules for turning libraries that manage their own DOM into components; setup in onBuilt, cleanup with setDisposable, untracked writes, DOM ownership conflicts, the root element and the single-copy rule.

pages.title: Publishing an npm Library for MotifJS
pages.description: Preparing an npm package with MotifJS components, services or wrappers; the package format, build, types, CSS, the prop contract, testing and pre-publish checks.

pages.title: The DevTools Contract
pages.description: The __MOTIF_DEVTOOLS__ object turned on by useDevelopment(true); paths, events, the tree, component contents, the reactivity trace, counters, router and error records, write operations.

pages.title: DevTools for Packages
pages.description: registerDevtools for packages (describe, inspect, sources, commands, panels, events, reveal), operations and write records; the core side of a package's own DevTools panel.

pages.title: Writing a Component Library
pages.description: Rules for a component library that applications use; props tracked by a single binding, the developer's data used as it is, nothing tracked inside the component, parts drawn by hand, writing only on change, a temporary attribute on the developer's component, the component an event came from, lifetime traps and measuring.

pages.title: API Reference
pages.description: A quick reference of the symbols exported from the @motifx/core package.

pages.title: Error and Warning Codes
pages.description: Every MJX code MotifJS produces; compiler codes, thrown and reported errors, development warnings, their console messages and what they mean.

pages.title: Collection Queries (Query)
pages.description: where/select/orderBy/groupBy chains with Query.from, the methods that produce a result, and use with reactivity.

pages.title: Collections
pages.description: The API and behaviour of the List, Dictionary, NameValuePair and LinkedList structures that come with @motifx/core.

pages.title: Frame
pages.description: A container that holds a single changing piece of content; swapping content with navigate, timing, leave transitions, and the places where the framework sets up a Frame.

pages.title: Lazy
pages.description: Content loaded through a dynamic import or any Promise; the loading flow, options, retries, cancellation and error reporting.

pages.title: Transport and TransportTo
pages.description: Showing content in a slot outside its own tree; the Transport slot, the TransportTo sender, the replace/merge modes and Transporter for moving content in code.

pages.title: ContentBody and ContentBlock
pages.description: A body that several blocks fill together; the ContentBody body, ContentBlock parts, piling up, disposal and how it differs from Transport.

pages.title: Virtual Lists (Virtualization)
pages.description: The Virtualization component; props, the dataRequest contract, automatic refresh, templates, filtering, variable height, the rendering model and methods.
